notes: Customer: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Use LLMs to power conversational support + in-app contextual help and faster doc search.
Trial w/ Hosted API ran for 3 weeks (Dec 2025-Jan 2026). Ran 2 main flows: short-turn support Qs and long-form summarization for docs.
POC takeaway: response quality good on curated open model RAVEN-2; latency median ~120ms for short prompts, p95 ~420ms when requests spike.
Cost signals: hosted per-token cost acceptable in trial, but projected monthly cost at scale (5M tokens/mo) pushes them to explore Dedicated.
Quote from Head of Engineering: 'Need predictable economics and traffic isolation — can't have noisy neighbors during support peaks.'
Security: must pass SOC2-type controls, SSO via SAML, encryption w/ customer KMS, and 1-year audit log retention. Residency: US-only for now.
AE notes: customer is comfortable with Redwood SDKs from trial. Wants deterministic latency and runway on cost before committing to reserved capacity.
SE notes: provided preliminary batching and caching suggestions; recommended enabling prefix KV cache for doc-search to reduce token spend by ~30%.
Procurement: prefers a 12-month committed capacity contract but will accept 6-month if pricing flexibility included. Finance wants ARR visibility.

traffic_forecast: Current (trial): avg 8 QPS, daily peak 40 QPS during support windows; token mix: ~75% short queries (<120 tokens), 20% medium summaries (300-1k tokens), 5% long-form (1k-3k tokens).
Projected Yr1 (scaled product rollout): avg 20 QPS, peak 120 QPS, monthly tokens ~12M. Expect 60/30/10 token distribution short/medium/long respectively.
Concurrency target: maintain p95 latency <350ms for short queries at 99th percentile; support concurrency of 25-30 concurrent live chat sessions during peak.
Batching/caching assumptions: enabling prefix caching reduces token churn for doc-search by ~30%; batching yields 1.5-2x throughput uplift for medium requests.
dedicated_capacity_requirements: Prelim sizing: 2-3 x A10G-equivalent GPUs for baseline (handles avg 20 QPS, p95 target met with KV cache), scale to 6 GPUs for peak 120 QPS with headroom.
Autoscale policy: base pool of 2 GPUs + burst to 6 within 2 minutes; warm cache nodes preferred to reduce cold-start latency.
Throughput assumptions: 1 GPU handles ~8-12 short-query QPS with optimized kernel + quantized model; medium requests lower throughput and increase memory/kv usage.
Fallback plan: route to hosted_api-compatible variant if dedicated pool exhausted; must ensure consistent model weights across variants to avoid quality regressions.
pricing_notes: Customer requested 3-tier pricing: conservative (initial), expected (mid), heavy (peak) with corresponding GPU commit levels and overage rates.
Finance asks: show blended per-token economics vs hosted API and committed monthly cost for dedicated (include amortized infra + support).
Discounts: willing to discuss 10-15% on 12-month commit; open to performance SLAs tied to uptime and p95 latency.
technical_risks: Peak contention during nightly batch jobs from analytics team — needs routing isolation or quota enforcement.
Embeddings pipeline currently uses third-party vector db with spikes that could increase QPS unexpectedly.
Customer legal wants indemnity language around model hallucinations for summarized outputs.
